description: Generalisation check for Head C, written AFTER the rule provider's keyword lists (unlike assistant_golden.json, which was written first). Natural phrasings that deliberately avoid the obvious keywords, to measure how much of the rule baseline's golden-set score is overfitting to the questions its author had seen.
